record.field: See every project
Without it a person sees only the projects whose team they are on.
Set up projects
Start a new project and change a project's configuration: rooms, trades, team, drawing list, client.
Update the work grid
Set a work line as working, waiting or done.
Drawings
Make drawings, send them for approval, release them, answer the questions on them.
Approve drawings
Approve a drawing before it is released, or send it back.
MOM and points
Write points on site, send each agency its PDF, check and close points.
Agencies
Add agencies, and choose the agency of a project's trade.
Bills
Ask an agency for a bill, upload it on its behalf, accept or return it.
Bill amounts and payments
See bill amounts and money totals, and record payments.
Setup
Rules, day limits, trades, room types, drawing sets, and the roles and access of staff.
